disclaimer_title: Review this medical and AI usage agreement before continuing.
disclaimer_subtitle: DiagnoAI is designed to help users understand laboratory values, visualize patterns in results, and provide AI-generated commentary. It is not a replacement for clinical judgment or direct medical care.
disclaimer_warning_text: This application is an AI support tool only. It estimates a research risk signal from CBC/ESR values. It does not confirm pancreatic cancer, prescribe treatment, or replace a licensed doctor. Every result must be reviewed with a qualified healthcare professional.
disclaimer_purpose_1: Helps people read laboratory numbers in a clearer and more organized way.
disclaimer_purpose_2: Visualizes submitted results so patterns and possible risk signals are easier to understand.
disclaimer_purpose_3: Generates AI commentary that can support questions for a doctor or medical team.
disclaimer_limits_title: What this tool does not do
disclaimer_limits_1: It does not provide a final medical conclusion or guarantee accuracy for every patient.
disclaimer_limits_2: It should never be the only basis for treatment decisions, delaying care, or avoiding a doctor visit.
disclaimer_limits_3: Abnormal results, symptoms, or persistent concerns still require medical evaluation by a licensed physician.
disclaimer_limits_4: In urgent or emergency situations, seek immediate care from a hospital, doctor, or local emergency services.
disclaimer_agree_1: You understand this product provides educational AI assistance and result visualization only.
disclaimer_agree_2: You will consult a doctor or qualified healthcare professional for clinical evaluation, confirmation of concerns, and care decisions.
disclaimer_agree_3: You accept that AI commentary may be incomplete, incorrect, or not appropriate for your exact health condition.
disclaimer_emergency_title: Do not rely on this app alone
disclaimer_emergency_text: If you feel unwell, have concerning symptoms, or receive worrying lab values, use this app as a supporting step only and contact a doctor for proper medical assessment.
disclaimer_data_notice: Only enter information you are allowed to share. Avoid using the tool for emergencies, critical decisions, or situations where a direct medical examination is needed.
disclaimer_checkbox: I have read and understood this agreement. I understand that DiagnoAI is only an AI support tool, and I will still consult a doctor for medical evaluation and follow-up.

about_subtitle: Research prototype for CBC/ESR-based risk signal analysis
about_heading: Research prototype for explainable CBC/ESR risk assessment
about_mission_p1: DiagnoAI Pancreas supports pancreatic cancer risk assessment from structured blood-test indicators. The system provides risk stratification, explanations, and reports for research and educational review.
about_mission_p2: Pancreatic cancer requires full clinical evaluation, so this system only studies a limited laboratory risk signal and helps prepare questions for further physician review.
about_guardrails_title: What the system does not claim
about_guardrail_1: It does not confirm pancreatic cancer or replace clinical judgement.
about_guardrail_2: It uses only 18 CBC/ESR indicators, not imaging, biopsy, symptoms, or medical history.
about_guardrail_3: The result is a research risk signal that must be reviewed by a qualified physician.
about_guardrail_4: AI commentary is limited to explanation and safety wording, not treatment advice.
about_pillar_1_desc: The interface combines probability, risk level, and SHAP factors so the result can be inspected instead of treated as a black box.
about_pillar_2_desc: Patients, doctors, and researchers receive wording appropriate to their role while the underlying model output stays unchanged.
about_pillar_3_desc: The project is suitable for bachelor-level research demonstration, not direct clinical deployment.
features_subtitle: Engineering features of a research prototype
features_role_desc: Patient, doctor, researcher, and admin roles keep saved analyses and tools separated.
features_history_desc: Authenticated users can review previous assessments and probability trends over time.
features_signature_desc: Doctor accounts can generate structured PDF reports with patient context and project disclaimers.
features_dashboard_desc: Researcher accounts can inspect saved records, risk distributions, and prominent laboratory features.
feat_ai_desc: Random Forest Classifier trained on the reproducible cleaned CBC/ESR dataset.
feat_shap_desc: Transparent explanations of how each biomarker contributes to the risk score.
feat_sec_desc: Authentication, role checks, audit logging, and request limits are implemented; production deployment still requires a formal security review.
feat_rt_desc: Fast calculation of risk probability, SHAP factors, and explanatory commentary.
feat_ehr_desc: EHR integration is not implemented and remains a possible future extension.
feat_fda_desc: The current system is a research prototype and does not claim formal regulatory approval.
